items.title: George Blanchin Interview, 1959-11-13
items.q: I can recall hearing, for instance, Ethel Waters, Sarah Martin, Esther Bijou, some of the Smith sisters.

ctx.x: You want to talk about the midnight shows now?

Well, I was thinking about the midnight shows at the Old Palace, I think it was, and the shows were, of course, for Negroes all during the week. It was a sort of a vaudeville circuit similar to the off-human circuits of that side except when it was Negroes. And each Friday night there was a midnight show for white people. And we, of course, tried never to miss it because, in addition to having a very good orchestra pit band, there were many good acts and good singers. I can recall hearing, for instance, Ethel…
What did he look like? Was he dark or light or...?
